title: Asana API Guide: Get Tasks, Projects, and Users in 2026
snippet:
Asana's API is a REST interface that speaks JSON at `https://app.asana.com/api/1.0`, and you can list tasks with a personal access token and a `GET /tasks` call, the same kind of call that tools like [Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com) make under the hood when they talk to Asana.

The official reference lives at [developer.asana.com](https://developer.asana.com/reference).

You create a personal access token from your own account's developer settings, and Asana's developer documentation describes the API as available to Asana accounts.
Plan details change over time. Confirm them on Asana's pricing page and the developer docs before you build a dependency on a particular tier. To check access, make a single `GET /users/me` call with your token.

You pay for every page in requests. Asana caps them at 1,500 per minute on a paid domain, 150 on a free domain and 60 for the Search API, according to [Asana's rate-limits page](https://developers.asana.com/docs/rate-limits).

At 150 requests per minute on a free domain, a project with 10,000 tasks, paged at 100 per request, uses about 100 calls for one full read.
A second read in the same minute would exceed your quota, so you may need to wait for the Retry-After period before refreshing that data.
Move to a paid domain at 1,500 and you get roughly ten times that room.
Tightest of all is the Search API at 60 per minute. A workflow that searches once per task will stall after one minute's worth of tasks and need backoff on the 429 responses.

You won't find a per-call price in the documentation. Access appears to come with the plan, so the cost is the seat price. [G2's Asana pricing page](https://www.g2.com/products/asana/pricing) lists **Personal at $0 per user per month**, Starter at $10.99 and Advanced at $24.99.

Because Personal is free, you can build and test against the API at no cost, but it sits under the 150-per-minute free ceiling. Starter at $10.99 per user is the cheapest tier listed above that free plan.

title: Asana Pricing in 2026: Starter vs Advanced, Seat Blocks, and What AI Requests Cost
snippet:
As of October 11, 2026, Asana Starter costs $10.99 per user a month billed annually ($13.49 monthly) and Advanced $24.99 ($30.49 monthly), with custom Enterprise pricing and a free plan for 2 users.

**As of October 11, 2026, Asana Starter costs $10.99 per user a month billed annually or $13.49 billed monthly, Advanced costs $24.99 annually or $30.49 monthly, and Enterprise and Enterprise+ are quoted by sales. The free Personal plan covers 2 users.

| Plan | Billed annually | Billed monthly | Users | AI Teammates and Dash | AI Studio credits |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Personal | $0 | $0 | Up to 2 | Not listed | Not listed |
| Starter | $10.99 per user | $13.49 per user | Unlimited | 5 requests per user a month, up to 50 per account | 50,000 per billing account a month |
| Advanced | $24.99 per user | $30.49 per user | Unlimited | 5 per user, up to 50 per account | 75,000 |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Unlimited | 5 per user, up to 250 per account | 200,000 |
| Enterprise+ | Custom | Custom | Unlimited | 5 per user, up to 250 per account | 200,000 |
Starter adds timeline and Gantt views, reporting dashboards, unlimited automations, forms, custom templates, custom fields and unlimited free guests. Advanced adds portfolios, goals, resource management within a portfolio, approvals and proofing, forms with branching, time tracking and connections to Salesforce, Tableau and Power BI. Enterprise adds SAML, SCIM provisioning, organization-wide capacity planning, service accounts for integrations and view-only licenses. Timesheets and Budgets is a paid add-on on every paid plan; compliance and permissions management are add-ons on Enterprise.

The API is where Asana meters builders, and the free plan is ten times slower than paid:
- **Standard limit:** about 150 requests a minute per token on a free domain and about 1,500 on a paid one.
- **Search API:** 60 requests a minute, on any plan.
- **Concurrency:** no more than 50 read and 15 write requests in flight at once, counted separately.
- **Jobs:** 5 concurrent duplication, template or export jobs per user, including ones started in the web app.

title: Premium vs Business Account and API Access
snippet:
If you pay for any plan, you have access to the full API, including 1500 request/minute and the “search” endpoint.
Only free accounts are limited to 150 calls/minute, and they can’t access the “search tasks” endpoint.
